Subject: COI and next steps for Redwood onboarding

Hi Rishi —

Attached is our certificate of insurance (COI) and the broker's endorsement stub. Per our internal procurement requirements we try to include the following endorsement language:

  • Additional insured: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  • Waiver of subrogation: in favor of Redwood Inference
  • Primary and noncontributory wording for general liability

We also need to confirm the PO routing and whether Redwood requires any specific invoicing fields (tax ID, remit-to). We are ready to provide a signed SOW once the insurance suffices for legal.

Attachments: QuantumData_Master_COI.pdf (pdf), broker_stub.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —

Elena —

Thanks for sending these over. Quick notes after a first pass:

  1) The COI looks standard but we need the broker to add the Additional Insured endorsement specifically naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees".
  2) We require language that the endorsement applies to ongoing and completed operations.
  3) For the PO: finance needs QuantumData's legal name, billing address, VAT/tax ID, and the email to which the invoice will be sent. If you can provide those fields we can queue the PO.

Laura — can you confirm whether the COI as attached triggers any conditional hold? Mina — please advise if we need the waiver of subrogation to be documented differently for EU vendors.

If the broker can provide the formal endorsement PDF, we can accept it and move to PO issuance.

Next steps I will take once we have the endorsement:
  • Legal review final sign-off (target: 24 hours)
  • Finance opens PO (target: 48–72 hours after endorsement received)

Best,
Rishi

Hi all —

Apologies for the delay. Attached is the formal endorsement template with the additional insured field completed to read exactly: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees". We also added the operations wording and waived subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted.

Please note:
  • Some EU policies route waiver of subrogation through an internal claims endorsement — if Redwood needs explicit contractual language we can escalate to underwriter, but that typically adds 3–5 business days.
  • I included a short broker note with the policy effective/expiry dates.

Attachments: endorsement_template_brokerco.pdf (pdf), broker_note.txt (text)

Let me know if you need anything else from our side to get the PO queued.

—Marco

Elena / procurement team —

Received the endorsed PDF from Marco, thanks. Laura / Mina confirmed via quick review: the endorsement language meets Redwood's standard requirements and we do not need to send to underwriter for the waiver (good).

Action items to get PO and SOW moving:
  1) QuantumData: please reply with the legal name for invoicing, VAT ID, billing address, and the invoice email.
  2) QuantumData: confirm whether invoices will include a purchase order number field and who on your side should be referenced on POs (name/email).
  3) Marco/BrokerCo: please provide the final broker note (policy number + effective/expiry) as a single PDF for our contract file.

Once we have #1 and #3, Finance will create a conditional PO and Legal will prepare the SOW for signature. Target timeline: PO in 48 hours after receipt of required fields.

If procurement prefers a DocuSign for the SOW, share the signer and email and I will ask Legal to prepare it.

Thanks —
Rishi
